content_text: [1/14 @parthi_logan] A protein bar with 28g of protein and 150 kcal shouldn't be possible. The protein alone is 112 kcal. That leaves 38 kcal for everything that makes it taste good. The David bar does it anyway, so I read the label. --- [2/14 @parthi_logan] The ingredient is EPG, listed as "modified plant-based oil." I think it's one of the most important food technologies of the decade. GLP-1s make you want less food. EPG lets chocolate, candy and chips keep their taste with a fraction of the fat calories. --- [3/14 @parthi_logan] EPG is esterified propoxylated glycerol. Take a plant oil, split it into glycerol and fatty acids, and reconnect them with a food-grade link. It tastes like fat, but your enzymes can't break it apart, so it mostly passes through. Fat is 9 kcal/g. EPG is 0.7. --- [4/14 @parthi_logan] We've seen this movie before. Olestra, P&G's fat replacer from the 90s, stayed liquid in your gut and caused the problems it's still famous for. EPG stays solid at body temperature, so normal amounts don't do that. Eat a ton and you can still have issues. --- [5/14 @parthi_logan] About 11% of US adults are on a GLP-1 in 2026, up from 3% two years ago. Most never built the habits you need on a cut, lifting and eating your bodyweight in protein, so they lose muscle along with the fat. --- [6/14 @parthi_logan] So they get told to eat more protein. That's a big reason for the protein craze. 38,000+ supermarket products now advertise protein, whey prices are at record highs, and I've seen a protein espresso martini. --- [7/14 @parthi_logan] Then people stop. Roughly 40% come off within a year, and many regain a lot of the weight. Getting protein in is doable. The hard part is that the cravings for the foods they love come back. --- [8/14 @parthi_logan] That's where EPG fits. On the drug you need protein. Off it you want candy, chips and ice cream again. A fat that tastes like fat at a tenth of the calories helps with both. --- [9/14 @parthi_logan] GLP-1s scaled in steps: diabetes drug, obesity drug, telehealth subscription, daily pill. The Wegovy pill did 2M+ prescriptions within months of launch. EPG can scale the same way. One bar to the whole snack aisle. One brand to every food company. --- [10/14 @parthi_logan] Then restaurants. EPG has been through the FDA's process for some commercial frying, and lower-calorie fries are a far bigger market than protein bars. The end state is Coke Zero. People buy it because it tastes like Coke, not because it's diet. --- [11/14 @parthi_logan] Right now one company controls it. Peter Rahal (RXBAR founder) runs Medici Brands, David's parent. In 2025 David bought Epogee, the only commercial EPG maker, and stopped selling it to other brands. --- [12/14 @parthi_logan] David did ~$130M its first year and is on track for $300M+ in 2026. Medici raised $250M at $2.25B in September and is moving into ice cream, shakes, candy and chips. I buy it myself. The shake is the best shelf-stable one I've had. --- [13/14 @parthi_logan] I'd love to invest in calorie-cutting food tech that's available to every food company, not just one. If you're building an ingredient, process or platform that helps brands add protein and cut calories without losing taste, DM me. --- [14/14 @parthi_logan] Full essay: https://parthilogan.substack.com/p/epg-is-the-next-glp-1 If this was useful, a repost of the first tweet helps it reach more people.
